description: Drive BB from the keyboard: hold a modifier to see every shortcut, and set up a new thread with number keys. Holding Command or Ctrl shows the remaining keys as small pills beside the visible controls, following your current bindings. While the prompt is empty, 1 to 4 open the project, model, machine, and branch pickers, and numbers pick their options. Slash opens thread search, and Command+P opens the Plugins page once you free that key from Quick open file. Each part can be turned off in plugin settings.
